about_the_game:
Meet Naomi!

Meet Naomi — the unstoppable party girl who's never heard the word "no". Disorderly conduct comes with a price, but she couldn't care less. The orange prison jumpsuit is already slipping off her shoulders, and there's a key to the cuffs gleaming between her teeth... Breaking out of jail is just another side quest for Naomi, and she's nearly free!

Does Naomi like erotic roleplay? She adores it. She's all about rough, dangerous stories where the heroine's life hangs by a thread. And she has one golden rule: the greater the danger, the stronger the orgasm.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING?

By purchasing this DLC, you unlock Naomi in her Fatal Inmate outfit. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in-game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
